plans.title: Coffee & glassmaking
plans.intro: An indoor-focused outing between Hawley and White Mills. The Factory Museum is seasonal and normally closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

stops.note: Start with coffee or lunch; seasonal hours are on the place card.
Visit the glassmaking exhibits. April 15–December 15; winter visits by appointment.

plans.title: A warm-weather family day
plans.intro: A summer plan, not an outing for the current winter season. Both the animal park and swimming beach have seasonal access.

stops.note: Woodland animal park. Currently closed for the season; confirm spring reopening.
Public swimming beach in summer. Confirm current opening dates, fees and weather.
A bakery stop before its afternoon closing time.

plans.title: Dinner & a waterfall view
plans.intro: Choose dinner at The Settlers Inn, then a separately arranged visit to Glass at Ledges if its hours and availability suit. Reservations are not included.

stops.note: Farm-to-table restaurant in Hawley; check dining hours and reserve directly.
Glass wine.bar.kitchen overlooks the falls. Check availability before travelling.
